display.purpose: Drop capital and the largest dice result. Rare.

title.purpose: Modal titles and section headings, 16 to 18px.

body.purpose: All prose, 13 to 15px, always upright. Flavour text, hints and sub-lines are the same face one step down the text ramp.

label.purpose: Buttons, panel titles, tabs. Uppercase Cinzel at the 11px floor. Field labels run a step heavier: Cinzel 600, 12px, 0.14em, text-2.

numeric.purpose: Any figure compared or totalled: HP, ability scores, dice, currency. Tabular.

themes.name: midnight
themes.note: Default. Values in DESIGN.md frontmatter are this theme.

themes.name: vellum
themes.note: Light parchment. Same token names, inverted ramp; the primary button label switches to gold-deep.

themes.name: candlelit
themes.note: Warm sepia. Starlight turns amber here.

shadows.name: ambient-page
shadows.purpose: var(--shadow). Modals and drawers only, the one place something sits above the page. Never used to separate elements.

shadows.name: focus-glow-gold
shadows.purpose: var(--glow-gold). Input focus (state), plus the one standing glow in the system: the primary button at rest. A second standing glow is a bug.

shadows.name: live-glow-celestial
shadows.purpose: var(--glow). Active or live session state only. A celestial glow at rest is always a bug.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default for button, chip and control state changes. 0.15s is the house duration.

motion.name: row-hover
motion.purpose: Roster rows and other dense list rows.

motion.name: meter-fill
motion.purpose: Vitals bar and other meters changing value.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: The phone drawer; its scrim fades over the same 0.25s.

motion.name: overlay-in
motion.purpose: Modal backdrop arriving. Toasts use 0.2s ease-out with a 10px rise.

motion.name: slideover-in
motion.purpose: Left slide-over; starts only 34px off so a frozen timeline still shows it.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }
motion.purpose: One global rule. Every animation and transition becomes an instant change and infinite animations run once and stop, so any state an animation shows must also live on the element. Motion is CSS-only; @angular/animations is deliberately absent.

components.name: Button
components.description: The base control: hairline border, uppercase Cinzel label, near-sharp corner. Disabled turns the hairline dashed and drops border and label to text-dim, never opacity.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs); letter-spacing: var(--track-label); text-transform: uppercase; padding: 9px 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-2); border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { color: var(--gold); border-color: var(--gold); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled, .ds-btn:disabled:hover { background: transparent; border-color: var(--text-dim); border-style: dashed; color: var(--text-dim); box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committing action. Gradient fill mixed from gold into the raised surface, gold border, and the only standing glow in the system.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs); letter-spacing: var(--track-label); text-transform: uppercase; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--gold); color: var(--gold-2); border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--gold) 30%, var(--surface-2)), color-mix(in oklch, var(--gold-deep) 25%, var(--surface-2))); box-shadow: var(--glow-gold); transition: all .15s; } :host-context([data-theme="vellum"]) .ds-btn-primary { color: var(--gold-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: var(--text); background: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--gold) 40%, var(--surface-2)), color-mix(in oklch, var(--gold-deep) 30%, var(--surface-2))); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: The base button with a crimson label and a 50% crimson hairline; hover fills with crimson at 20%. The play variant is the same in emerald (55% border, 22% fill).
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs); letter-spacing: var(--track-label); text-transform: uppercase; padding: 9px 14px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--crimson) 50%, transparent); color: var(--crimson); border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--crimson) 20%, transparent); border-color: var(--crimson); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset ground, hairline border, gold focus border and glow. Label is Cinzel 600 12px at 0.14em in text-2; a rule the field enforces sits under it as a 12px text-dim hint. Disabled keeps readable ink and turns the hairline dashed.
components.html: At least 2 characters.
components.css: .ds-field { margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-field label { display: block; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: var(--text-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-2); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); padding: 9px 12px; font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-base); border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); outline: none; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: var(--glow-gold); } .ds-field input:disabled { color: var(--text-2); -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--text-2); opacity: 1; border-style: dashed; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-field-hint { margin-top: 6px; font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-xs); line-height: 1.4; color: var(--text-dim); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The repeating container: translucent surface over a blurred backdrop, hairline border with a fainter inner hairline, 3px corner. No shadow.
components.html:
Ability Scores

Strength, Dexterity, Constitution.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface) 75%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); padding: 18px 20px; backdrop-filter: blur(4px); } .ds-panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border-soft); border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-panel > * { position: relative; } .ds-panel-header { margin-bottom: 14px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--text-xs); letter-spacing: var(--track-micro); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); margin: 0; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-md); line-height: 1.45; color: var(--text); margin: 0; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: The app-modal shell: surface box, accent hairline (gold, or celestial / crimson by tone), a title that names the dialog and a close button top-right. Ambient shadow, no glow.
components.html:
Long Rest

The party rests for eight hours.
components.css: .ds-modal { position: relative; box-sizing: border-box; width: min(520px, 92vw); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 28px 32px 24px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .ds-modal::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); pointer-events: none; } .ds-modal > * { position: relative; } .ds-modal-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--text-xl); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--gold); margin: 0 40px 4px 0; } .ds-modal-close { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 20px; width: 36px; height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); color: var(--text-dim); cursor: pointer; transition: color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-modal-close:hover { color: var(--gold); border-color: var(--border); } .ds-modal-sub { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-md); color: var(--text-2); margin: 0; }

components.name: Condition Chip
components.description: A pill toggle for conditions and tags. At rest a quiet hairline pill; selected, accent text on an 18% mix of the same accent. The fill carries the selection.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-chip" aria-pressed="true">Poisoned</button> <button type="button" class="ds-chip" aria-pressed="false">Prone</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: var(--text-2xs); letter-spacing: var(--track-label); text-transform: uppercase; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); color: var(--text-2); background: var(--bg-2); cursor: pointer; transition: all .15s; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--gold); border-color: var(--gold); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--crimson) 18%, var(--bg-2)); border-color: var(--crimson); color: var(--crimson); }

components.name: Roster Row
components.description: A navigation row in the 320px rail: Cinzel name, upright Newsreader sub-line in text-dim. The active row takes a celestial tint and a gold left marker, with aria-current set.
components.html: Lyra MoonwhisperHalf-Elf Bard
components.css: .ds-nav-row { position: relative; display: block; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background .12s, border-color .12s; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface-2) 80%, transparent); } .ds-nav-row--active { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--celestial) 14%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--celestial) 35%, transparent); } .ds-nav-row--active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -8px; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 2px; background: var(--gold); } .ds-nav-name { display: block; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: var(--text-sm); letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: var(--text); } .ds-nav-meta { display: block; font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--text-dim); }

components.name: Sheet Tabs
components.description: The character sheet's section tabs. The active tab takes pale starlight ink and a 2px underline. Below 820px the row pins to the bottom edge as a 52px bar.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs" role="tablist"><button type="button" class="ds-tab ds-tab--active" role="tab" aria-selected="true">Sheet</button><button type="button" class="ds-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Spells</button><button type="button" class="ds-tab" role="tab" aria-selected="false">Inventory</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-soft); } .ds-tab { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--text-dim); font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-size: var(--text-sm); letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab--active { color: var(--celestial-2); border-bottom-color: var(--celestial-2); }

components.name: Context Help Button
components.description: The "?" in a panel header or beside a disabled button: a tooltip on hover and focus, a small dialog on tap. A 28px circle with an invisible 44px tap halo on touch.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-help" aria-label="Help: Spell slots" aria-haspopup="dialog">?</button>
components.css: .ds-help { position: relative; width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; cursor: help; } .ds-help:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-help::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -8px; } }

components.name: Vitals Bar
components.description: Signature component. A thin meter under an eyebrow label and a large value; the fill runs crimson to gold and drops to flat crimson when bloodied.
components.html:
Hit Points
27 / 43
components.css: .ds-vital { padding: 18px 16px; text-align: center; } .ds-eyebrow { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: var(--text-2xs); letter-spacing: var(--track-micro); text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-dim); } .ds-vital-value { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 30px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--text); } .ds-vital-sub { font-family: 'Newsreader', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: var(--text-md); color: var(--text-dim); } .ds-vital-bar { margin-top: 10px; height: 3px; background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); overflow: hidden; } .ds-vital-bar > span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: var(--radius-sharp); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--crimson), var(--gold)); transition: width .25s ease-out; } .ds-vital--bloodied .ds-vital-bar > span { background: var(--crimson); }

narrative.overview:
Table Mimic reads as a star chart kept by a cartographer who also runs a dungeon. The ground is deep midnight; the marks on it are gold leaf and starlight blue. Sigils and faint radial washes sit behind the content like constellations drawn on the page, never competing with it. The register is arcane and cosmic rather than bookish — this is an instrument for navigating a campaign, not a rulebook to be read.

The system is restrained by intent. Chrome is thin: hairline borders, near-sharp corners, a single hairline-bordered panel that repeats everywhere. Colour does the work that borders and boxes do in other systems — the accent is scarce and meaningful, and ornament is confined to the background. Depth is tonal, never lifted.

One thing makes this system unusual and governs everything else: it ships three complete themes, and all three are first-class. The token names are constant; their values are redefined per theme. A screen that only holds together in the default theme is not finished.
keyCharacteristics: Gold and starlight accents on a deep midnight ground, with two sibling themes
Inscriptional caps (Cinzel) for labels, editorial serif (Newsreader) for prose, mono for numbers
Near-sharp corners (2–3px); pills reserved for status
Tonal depth through three stacked surface steps, never drop shadows
Glow is a state signal, not decoration
Dense by nature — built for glanceable reading on a phone at a table

rules.name: The Three Themes Rule
rules.body: midnight (default), vellum (light parchment) and candlelit (sepia) redefine every token above under a [data-theme] selector. Never write a literal colour in a component — the token is the only interface. A change verified in one theme is unverified.

rules.name: The AA Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text token clears 4.5:1 against every surface token, in every theme — 135 combinations, enforced by npm run check:contrast in CI. Adding or darkening a token without re-running it is how this breaks.

rules.name: The Scarce Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold marks what is active, valuable, or focused. When most of a screen is gold, none of it is.

rules.name: The Ramp Separation Rule
rules.body: The three text steps sit roughly 1.4× apart in contrast. Fixing a contrast failure by sliding one step toward another collapses the ramp; move its neighbour too.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text ships below 11px. Letterspaced micro-labels are functional text and are not exempt; being on the scale does not launder a legibility failure.

rules.name: The Tracking Ladder Rule
rules.body: Tracking rises as size falls: 0.04em on display, 0.05em on titles, 0.18em on buttons, 0.22em on the smallest eyebrow labels. Uppercase Cinzel below 12px without tracking is illegible.

rules.name: The No Italics Rule
rules.body:
Nothing is set in italic or oblique, in any theme (owner decision, 2026-11-18). No stylesheet or template declares font-style: italic, no italic font face is loaded, and the elements a browser slants by default (em, i, cite, dfn, address, var) are reset to upright once, globally, in src/styles.css. Secondary text (hints, sub-lines, empty states, notes, flavour) is told apart from the line above it by, in order of preference: 1. one step down the text ramp (text → text-2 → text-dim); 2. one step down the --text-* scale, never below the 11px floor; 3. weight (Newsreader 400 against 500 or 600); 4. an accent token, only where the text carries that meaning (crimson for an error, celestial for a magic item, gold for a title).

Two lines that share family, size, weight and colour are one line to the eye; when a note sits under a meta line, the note (someone wrote it) takes text-2 and the meta (generated) keeps text-dim. Emphasis inside a sentence stays an <em> and steps up the ramp to text; a run-in label ("At higher levels.") also takes weight 600. npm run check:tokens fails on any italic declaration under src/.

rules.name: The Panel Owns Its Scroll Rule
rules.body: The shell never scrolls. A new surface that needs to scroll scrolls inside its panel, not by growing the page.

rules.name: The Phone Is The Table Rule
rules.body: Players hold phones during play. Any session surface must stay workable at 375px — dense is acceptable, cramped and clipped are not.

rules.name: The Glow Is State Rule
rules.body: Glow signals focus, activity, or liveness. Never apply it to make something look richer at rest.

rules.name: The One Standing Glow
rules.body: Exactly one element breaks the rule above by design: the primary button carries the gold glow at rest, because on a dark ground it is how the committing action announces itself. It is the only standing glow in the system. A second standing glow is a bug, and a celestial glow at rest is always a bug.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px borders and tone. If a boundary needs more than a hairline to read, the tones on either side of it are wrong.

dos: Do write every colour as a token. The three themes are the product.
Do run npm run check:contrast after touching any colour token.
Do keep functional text at 11px or above, and raise tracking as size falls.
Do tell secondary text apart with the text ramp, a size step, weight or an accent token.
Do use tone and hairlines for structure; let surface → surface-2 → surface-3 carry depth.
Do keep the accent scarce — gold marks active, valuable, or focused.
Do verify at 375px before calling a session surface done.

Do write a failure as what did not happen and what to do next ("Could not save the note. Your text is still here — try again."), and an empty state as what is true plus the next step that exists at that width: the sidebar is a list on desktop and a drawer behind the menu button on a phone (.wide-only / .narrow-only).

Do put any state an animation shows on the element itself too. Under reduced motion the animation stops at rest, so a cue that lives only in keyframes disappears. The my-turn vignette holds its green frame statically for this reason.
donts: Don't introduce a drop shadow to separate elements. Change the tone step instead.
Don't leave a glow on an element at rest.
Don't soften the corner language; 2–3px is the house voice, pills are for status only.
Don't reach for a literal hex, #757575-style browser defaults included.
Don't set anything in italic: not a hint, not flavour text, not a placeholder, not an <em>. check:tokens fails the build on it.
Don't add @angular/animations. Motion here is CSS-only and deliberately so — the package was removed for 433 kB and should stay out.
Don't let a fix for one theme regress another; all three ship together.
